name: Sukhothai Marathon 2026
short_description: Sukhothai Marathon 2026 is on Sunday 11 October 2026 at Sukhothai Historical Park in Sukhothai, over 42.195 km, 21.2 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: Sukhothai Marathon 2026 is the fourth edition ("Chapter 4 - Spirit of the Dawn"), with every distance starting and finishing in Sukhothai Historical Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The organiser lists the Tourism Council of Sukhothai as organiser and Sukhothai Treasure Resort & Spa as presenter. The marathon starts at 03:00 and the 21.2 km half marathon at 05:00; RUNLAH lists the half as 21.5 km, but the organiser site says 21.2 km.

faqs.question: What are the start times and cut-offs at Sukhothai Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The marathon starts at 03:00 with a 7-hour limit and an intermediate cut-off at 22 km at 07:00. The 21.2 km starts at 05:00 (4 hours 30 minutes), the 10 km at 05:30 (2 hours 30 minutes) and the 5 km at 06:00 (1 hour).

faqs.question: How much does Sukhothai Marathon 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: The organiser lists THB 1,200 for the marathon, THB 1,000 for the 21.2 km, THB 800 for the 10 km and THB 600 for the 5 km. Registration runs through Checkrace, and system and payment fees are extra.
